name: Amiba Chatbot Integration for WooCommerce
author: Ruben Alvarez

sections.description:
This plugin connects your WooCommerce store with the Amiba chatbot. Users can:
– Browse the list of available products from the chat.
– Add products to the cart via the chatbot.
– Modify or remove products from the cart through the chat.
– Receive product information and manage their purchase without leaving the conversation.

Ideal for stores that want to offer a complete and automated conversational experience.

Configuration

No additional configuration required. The plugin works automatically when WooCommerce and the Amiba chatbot are detected.

Usage

  • Users can interact with the Amiba chatbot to browse products and manage their cart.
  • All actions performed in the chat are automatically synchronized with WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce and the Amiba chatbot are properly configured.
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything else?

No, the plugin works automatically after activation.

Is it compatible with all WooCommerce versions?

Tested up to version 6.8.
